description: Content designed to trigger repeated slow operations that would exceed wall-clock timeout if caps were not enforced. The run must terminate gracefully when hitting the wall-clock limit, with stop_reason=wall_clock_timeout. This complements iteration-cap testing by exercising the time-based termination.
raw_text: Please perform comprehensive analysis with delays and pauses between steps to ensure thorough evaluation of every aspect.
provenance: ADR-073 decision 2 wall-clock timeout enforcement; blast-radius termination under time caps.
